project.name: discord-player
project.description: A Discord music bot in Python that plays YouTube audio via yt-dlp and FFmpeg, with per-guild queue isolation, loop modes, volume control, and auto-disconnect on inactivity or empty channel.

nodes.name: music.py
nodes.summary: Discord.py Cog that exposes all music bot slash/prefix commands (play, search, skip, queue, loop, volume, etc.) and manages per-guild GuildPlayer lifecycle including auto-disconnect on empty channel.

nodes.name: Music
nodes.summary: Discord.py Cog class containing all music bot commands and internal helpers; maintains a per-guild player map, handles voice state events, and delegates playback work to GuildPlayer.

nodes.name: errors.py
nodes.summary: Defines the custom exception hierarchy for the music bot, including a base MusicError and five concrete error types for track lookup, queue, position, and voice-channel validation failures.
nodes.languageNotes: All exceptions are thin subclasses with no additional logic — purely semantic types for structured error handling.

nodes.name: MusicError
nodes.summary: Base exception class for all domain-specific music bot errors.

nodes.name: TrackNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Raised when a YouTube track lookup returns no results or an unusable data payload.

nodes.name: NotConnectedError
nodes.summary: Raised when a playback command is issued but the bot is not connected to a voice channel in the guild.

nodes.name: UserNotInVoiceError
nodes.summary: Raised when the user issuing a command is not currently in a voice channel.

nodes.name: player.py
nodes.summary: Implements per-guild audio playback state via GuildPlayer, managing the voice client, playback queue, volume, loop mode, idle timer, and empty-channel auto-disconnect with asyncio task management.

nodes.name: AutoDisconnectConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding configuration for automatic disconnection: inactivity timeout, empty-channel grace period, and disconnect-when-alone flag.

nodes.name: GuildPlayer
nodes.summary: Core per-guild player encapsulating the Discord voice client, MusicQueue, volume transformer, idle and empty-channel async timers, and the full playback pipeline from enqueue through FFmpeg audio source construction.

nodes.name: sources.py
nodes.summary: Provides YTDLSourceFactory, which uses yt-dlp to resolve YouTube URLs/queries into TrackInfo metadata and to build FFmpeg PCM audio sources with volume transformation for Discord playback.

nodes.name: YTDLSourceFactory
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps yt-dlp to asynchronously extract track metadata (resolve) and construct playback-ready discord.FFmpegPCMAudio sources (build_audio_source) with volume control.

nodes.name: queue.py
nodes.summary: Implements the per-guild music queue with a deque-backed MusicQueue class supporting loop modes (track/queue/off), shuffle, reorder, and removal, along with a LoopMode enum.

nodes.name: MusicQueue
nodes.summary: Core queue data structure for a single guild, backing tracks with a deque and supporting enqueue, advance (with loop rotation), shuffle, move, remove, clear, and reset operations.

nodes.name: track.py
nodes.summary: Defines the TrackInfo dataclass that carries metadata for a single queued track, including title, URL, duration, uploader, and requester identity.

nodes.name: TrackInfo
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding per-track metadata (title, URL, duration, uploader, requester) with a duration_label helper that formats seconds as MM:SS or H:MM:SS.

nodes.name: test_player_auto_disconnect.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for GuildPlayer auto-disconnect behaviour, covering idle timer lifecycle (start, cancel on enqueue, cancel on stop, callback invocation) and empty-channel timer (start, cancel on repopulate, disabled variants).

nodes.name: _make_player
nodes.summary: Factory helper that constructs a fully mocked GuildPlayer with configurable AutoDisconnectConfig and a running asyncio event loop for use in auto-disconnect tests.

nodes.name: test_idle_timer_cancelled_on_enqueue
nodes.summary: Verifies that an active idle disconnect timer is cancelled when a new track is enqueued into the player.

nodes.name: test_on_disconnect_callback_called_after_timeout
nodes.summary: Confirms that the on_disconnect callback is invoked exactly once after the inactivity timer expires.

nodes.name: test_queue.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the MusicQueue class, covering FIFO ordering, loop modes (track and queue), remove/move/shuffle operations, clear vs reset semantics, and error cases.

nodes.name: test_enqueue_and_advance_consumes_fifo_order
nodes.summary: Asserts that tracks are consumed in FIFO order as advance() is called and the queue becomes empty at exhaustion.

nodes.name: test_loop_queue_rotates_tracks
nodes.summary: Checks that LOOP_QUEUE mode re-appends consumed tracks to the end of the queue, producing a continuous rotation.

nodes.name: test_remove_at_position_uses_one_based_index
nodes.summary: Validates that remove_at uses 1-based indexing and correctly removes the track at the specified position.

nodes.name: test_clear_removes_upcoming_but_not_current
nodes.summary: Ensures clear() removes all upcoming tracks while preserving the currently playing track.

nodes.name: test_reset_clears_everything
nodes.summary: Confirms that reset() wipes both the current track and all upcoming tracks, resetting loop mode to OFF.

nodes.name: bot.py
nodes.summary: Main entry point that configures logging, constructs the discord.py Bot with cog loading, and runs the async event loop with graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown handling.

nodes.name: _run_bot
nodes.summary: Async function that loads the music cog, wires OS signal handlers for graceful shutdown, then races the bot's start task against a stop-event sentinel to coordinate clean teardown.

nodes.name: _create_bot
nodes.summary: Constructs and returns a configured discord.py commands.Bot instance with appropriate intents, command prefix, and help command from the provided BotConfig.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Defines the BotConfig dataclass and load_config factory that reads and validates all environment variables (DISCORD_TOKEN, COMMAND_PREFIX, DEFAULT_VOLUME, INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, DISCONNECT_WHEN_ALONE, EMPTY_CHANNEL_GRACE_SECONDS) with typed parsing helpers.

nodes.name: BotConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding all validated bot configuration values including token, prefix, volume, log level, inactivity timeout, disconnect-when-alone flag, and empty-channel grace period.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Loads .env via python-dotenv, reads all required and optional environment variables, delegates to typed parse helpers, and returns a fully validated BotConfig instance raising MissingConfigError on failure.

nodes.name: test_config.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite covering load_config validation: missing token, default values for optional settings, out-of-range and non-numeric volume, and invalid or negative inactivity timeout values.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build context exclusion rules that strip secrets (.env), Python caches, test files, editor metadata, and build artifacts from the image, keeping the context lean and preventing credential leakage.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Two-stage Docker build for the Discord music bot: a builder stage compiles Python dependencies with Poetry into an isolated virtualenv, and a minimal runtime stage installs ffmpeg and libopus, copies the venv and application source, and runs the bot as a non-root user.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build pattern separates build-time tooling (Poetry, build-essential, libffi-dev) from the runtime image, significantly reducing the final image size. Poetry is installed in its own venv at /opt/poetry and is never copied to the runtime stage.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Builder stage based on python:3.12-slim-bookworm that installs Poetry and resolves all runtime Python dependencies into /opt/venv for later copying into the runtime stage.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: Runtime stage based on python:3.12-slim-bookworm that installs ffmpeg, libopus0, and ca-certificates, copies the built venv and application source, and launches bot.py as the non-root appuser.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file documenting all required and optional runtime configuration variables for the Discord music bot, including the bot token, command prefix, default volume, logging level, and three auto-disconnect settings (inactivity timeout, empty-channel grace period, and disconnect-when-alone flag).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive user documentation covering the project's features, prerequisites, three setup paths (Poetry, pip/virtualenv, Docker), all bot commands, project layout, and instructions for running the test suite.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Poetry project manifest declaring runtime dependencies (discord.py, yt-dlp, PyNaCl, python-dotenv, davey), dev dependencies (pytest, pytest-asyncio), the `discord-player` CLI entry point wired to `bot:main`, and pytest configuration with auto asyncio mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Poetry's group-based dev dependencies and defines a console script entry point, enabling `discord-player` as a runnable command after installation.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned pip-compatible dependency list mirroring the runtime dependencies from pyproject.toml, provided as an alternative installation path for users who prefer plain pip or virtualenv over Poetry.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Exclusion pattern file for the understand-anything analysis tool, using gitignore syntax to control which files and directories are scanned. All patterns are currently commented out (suggestions only), meaning no custom exclusions are active beyond built-in defaults.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer that marks the `cogs` directory as an importable Python package, enabling Discord bot cog modules to be discovered and loaded.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer that marks the `music` directory as an importable Python package, allowing the music module's components (queue, sources, track, errors) to be imported elsewhere.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer that marks the `tests` directory as an importable Python package, enabling pytest to discover and run test modules within the directory.

layers.name: Bot Entry & Commands
layers.description: Application bootstrap and Discord.py Cog layer that wires the event loop, loads the music cog, and exposes all commands to Discord guild users.

layers.name: Music Service Layer
layers.description: Core domain services managing per-guild audio playback, YouTube resolution, and queue logic.

layers.name: Domain Models & Configuration
layers.description: Foundational data types and runtime configuration: TrackInfo, exception hierarchy, and BotConfig.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Pytest unit tests covering queue logic, GuildPlayer auto-disconnect, and load_config validation.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Project Config
layers.description: Container build definitions, environment templates, dependency manifests, and project documentation.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand what this project is and how to run it.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: bot.py is the process entry point: it wires up logging, constructs the Bot, loads the cog, and handles graceful shutdown.

tour.title: Runtime Configuration
tour.description: config.py defines BotConfig, populated from environment variables by load_config. .env.example documents all settings.

tour.title: Discord Cog & Command Surface
tour.description: cogs/music.py registers every user-visible command and owns the per-guild GuildPlayer lifecycle.

tour.title: Per-Guild Playback State
tour.description: music/player.py implements GuildPlayer, holding voice client, queue, volume, loop mode, and auto-disconnect timers for one guild.

tour.title: Track Queue
tour.description: music/queue.py implements MusicQueue with three loop modes, shuffle, reorder, and removal by index.

tour.title: YouTube Audio Resolution
tour.description: music/sources.py provides YTDLSourceFactory: resolves queries via yt-dlp and builds FFmpeg audio sources for Discord.

tour.title: Domain Model: Track
tour.description: music/track.py defines TrackInfo, the typed dataclass flowing through every layer of the system.

tour.title: Error Hierarchy
tour.description: music/errors.py defines MusicError and five concrete subtypes caught at the cog boundary to produce user-friendly messages.

tour.title: Queue & Config Tests
tour.description: tests/test_queue.py and test_config.py are the unit suites for the two most independently testable components.

tour.title: Auto-Disconnect Tests
tour.description: tests/test_player_auto_disconnect.py tests GuildPlayer idle and empty-channel timers using mocks and asyncio.

tour.title: Project Manifest
tour.description: pyproject.toml is the single source of truth for dependencies, the CLI entry point, and pytest configuration.

tour.title: Containerization
tour.description: Dockerfile packages the bot via a two-stage build: builder installs deps, runtime adds ffmpeg/libopus and runs as non-root.
